name: ddd

pattern.for: a part of a product designed with domain-driven design: its subdomains, bounded contexts, events and aggregates

summary: Domain-driven design for the parts of a product that follow it: subdomains, bounded contexts and their map, event storming (events, commands, reactions, read models, external systems) and the tactical model (aggregates, entities, value objects, business rules, domain services), on the architecture pack so a context's deployed component and its framework's node are one node; oto ddd storm reads an event-storming board into a document and a capture the gates take, and a named person signs each element off with oto decide. The engine ships no ddd: this pack is it.

changelog.note: Brought to the engine's line and made the only ddd there is (ADR-0010): the ddd ontology at release 3 on architecture, the storming importer and oto ddd storm as the module oto_ddd in ontology/ddd/code, the embedded ontologies at their current releases, the engine's ddd tests beside it. Needs OTO 0.14.7.
The studio's page: The domain model.
capture-form's three choices named in words; no quoting the engine.
Every conversation in plain language: no codes, ids or engine output, technical details only when asked (engine 0.11.22).
model-domain captures through OTO's capture-form with its menu, and is handed a part by the software-architecture pack.
ddd declares itself a pattern of software-architecture (model-domain). Needs OTO 0.11.17.
The DDD pattern for a part of a product: the ddd ontology and model-domain.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
